title: Why did others get it and not me?
subtitle: Possible reasons
intro: These are reasons that could explain why other cases moved sooner. We cannot know which one applies to your case.
national: Our estimate uses the national average for Cuban I-485s: the chance is the same with CHNV or CBP One, and with or without a work permit. What changes is your case's clock and these notes.
empty: We found no specific reasons for your case with the data we have.
closing: A neighbor's approval or a screenshot proves nothing about your case; always check on the official USCIS website.
ineligible: For this entry we do not compute estimates; see "Your entry".
